system: a returns and orders helper for a small online shop

failure_modes.name: wrong-refund-window
failure_modes.definition: The bot states a refund window that is not in the policy.

failure_modes.name: ignores-order-number
failure_modes.definition: The bot answers without using the order number the customer gave.

failure_modes.name: invents-stock
failure_modes.definition: The bot says an item is in stock without a stock lookup.

gate.blocks_on: any golden case that fails, or a judge pass rate below the last release
